name: From a stand to a card
says: How a company met at Web Summit becomes a GAMMA-Ray card with FACT-Ray trust on every fact: who does each step, a person, an agent or code, what each step leaves on record, and how far the facts can be trusted after it.

kinds.agent: an AI agent of this team
kinds.code: code: deterministic, the same input gives the same output

steps.name: Meet
steps.actor: Dinis Cruz, or the interview team
steps.does: Meets the company at its stand, at a talk or in an interview, and takes a photo or a note.
steps.leaves: A photo, held privately: it shows people

steps.name: Intake
steps.does: Writes down the stand's own words, exactly, with where and when.
steps.trust_reads: the company said it on its own stand; our record is not public; nobody has checked it

steps.name: Identify
steps.does: Names the company, the product and the part that may be an agent, with its domain.

steps.name: Is there an agent?
steps.does: Asks whether anything acts on its own. If not, the intake stays and no card is made. That is not a no.

steps.name: Read
steps.does: Reads the public pages, the documentation, the trust centre, llms.txt and the company's own /.well-known/fact-ray.json.
steps.trust_reads: we found it on a public page anyone can open; nobody else has checked it

steps.name: Capture
steps.does: Fetches every source once, hashes it, keeps it in a public vault.
steps.leaves: captures with SHA-256, and the vault

steps.name: Map
steps.actor: gamma.field@web-summit.dinis, with an assessor and a challenger
steps.does: Maps each piece of evidence to an indicator, with its source, grade, mode and the exact words. Never assigns a level.

steps.name: Score
steps.does: Computes the levels, the trust of each fact, and the card's graph down to the source.
steps.leaves: The card, its trust and its graph

steps.name: Review
steps.does: Two rounds: opens every source again and argues against every high level.
steps.trust_reads: captured, hashed and checked by another agent

steps.name: Sign off and publish
steps.does: Reads both rounds and signs off. The card is published as beta, with the status Draft.

steps.name: Talk
steps.actor: the interview team and Dinis Cruz, with gamma.studio@web-summit.dinis
steps.does: The interview links to the card. The company is asked to confirm or correct each fact, or to publish its own file; a customer to state how it uses the product.
steps.trust_reads: the company says it on its own domain, with a page to open

steps.name: Confirm or attest
steps.actor: the company, a customer, Dinis Cruz
steps.does: The company confirms (Confirmed), a customer goes on record (Attested), the operator signs a scope (A4). Every correction goes back to step 8.
steps.leaves: A card whose status follows its trust
steps.trust_reads: a customer on its own domain, signed by the person who answers for it

loops.says: a correction re-scores the card; nothing is deleted, the old fact is superseded
a finding goes back to the mapper, who answers it in the scan
